keyFindings.description: A document whose reference key is 2,049-2,692 bytes, which the head itself creates (maxNewArtifactKeyBytes 2692) and main stored, can no longer read its own references. text.ExtractAt drops a target past MaxTargetBytes (2048), so GET /references ?to=/?from= and block-links answer 400 INVALID_REFERENCE. DocumentPage's Referenced by panel then shows 'unavailable' and dispatch read prints '- unavailable'. Main answered 200. block_id_bound_test.go asserts the 400. Apply the target bound only where an edge is stored.

LongBlockID with live=nil refuses every id past 256 bytes, the document's own included. A rebuild with supplied markdown (docs/rebuild.go:94, parseInput) of stored text that main wrote is refused 400. A suggestion holding a long id is created 201 but its accept is always 400 (parseFragmentInput), and a suggestion main stored can no longer be accepted. Either drop the refusal (indexing already skips long ids, and asks and anchors are hashed) or make it consistent: refuse at suggestion creation, and pass the stored document as live on a rebuild.

The census lists only innerRefProblem. It needs the new refusals added in rounds 3-6: a new artifact's name or key past 2692 bytes (400 INVALID_ARTIFACT); a reference target past 2048 bytes (400 INVALID_REFERENCE on ?to=/?from=/block-links where main answered 200/404, and refused by envoy-client parseDispatchRef); and a new block id past 256 bytes through the API (400 INVALID_MARKDOWN/INVALID_OP), unless that refusal is dropped.

The dashboard reads /issues/K/spec?v=N#b-x as block x of the live spec. The server (text/refs.go documentPage) and envoy-client read it as the document version. Refuse a block on a spec route that carries ?v=, and add the row to the shared href table.
